import numpy as np
from collections import deque

inp = np.array([
[5,0,0,5,0],[5,0,0,5,0],[5,0,5,5,5],[5,5,5,0,0],[0,0,5,0,0],
[0,0,5,5,5],[0,0,0,5,0],[5,5,5,5,0],[0,5,0,0,0],[0,5,0,0,0],
[0,5,5,5,0],[0,0,0,5,0],[0,5,5,5,5],[5,5,0,0,0],[0,5,0,0,0]])
out = np.array([
[5,0,0,5,0],[5,0,0,5,0],[5,0,5,5,5],[5,5,5,0,0],[0,0,5,0,0],
[0,0,5,5,5],[0,0,0,5,8],[5,5,5,5,8],[0,5,8,8,8],[0,5,8,8,8],
[0,5,5,5,8],[0,0,0,5,8],[0,5,5,5,5],[5,5,0,0,0],[7,5,0,0,0]])

H,W=inp.shape
def regions(g):
    seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); regs=[]
    for i in range(g.shape[0]):
        for j in range(g.shape[1]):
            if g[i,j]==0 and not seen[i,j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i,j]=1; cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<g.shape[0] and 0<=nx<g.shape[1] and g[ny,nx]==0 and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=1; q.append((ny,nx))
                regs.append(cells)
    return regs
for r in regions(inp):
    touch=any(i in(0,inp.shape[0]-1) or j in(0,inp.shape[1]-1) for i,j in r)
    print(len(r), 'touch' if touch else 'enclosed', r[:5])
print('changed cells:', [(i,j,int(inp[i,j]),int(out[i,j])) for i,j in zip(*np.where(inp!=out))])
